pages.title: Glass Bowl
pages.text: Put an item in the bowl, then right-click with a $(thing)whisk$() to finish a whisking or beating recipe.$(br2)Right-click with a water bucket or water bottle to fill the bowl with water; then right-click with ingredients to make $(thing)mix with water$() recipes.$(br2)If the result is a packaged food, you must hold the matching $(thing)wrapper$() to take it out.

pages.title: Whisk
pages.text: Mostly used on the $(thing)Glass Bowl$(), using 1 durability per stir.$(br2)It can also break soft soil-type blocks quickly, but do not treat it as a shovel.

pages.title: Electric Whisk
pages.text: Holds $(thing)500 EP$() and can be recharged in a $(l:moderndelight:power_sys/charging_post)Charging Post$().$(br2)Right-click to $(thing)whisk a whole pile at once$(): every dropped item within 5 blocks that you are facing gets processed, 2 EP per item, an entire stack in one go.$(br2)It also works in the Glass Bowl, at 2 EP per use.

pages.title: Stone Mortar
pages.text: Hold what you want to grind in your $(thing)off hand$(), hold the mortar in your main hand and hold right-click; grinding finishes after 2 seconds.$(br2)The $(thing)Fine Grinding$() enchantment (up to level 3, from librarians) has a 20%% / 40%% / 60%% chance to add 1~2 / 1~3 / 1~4 extra of both the main and by-products.

pages.title: Knives
pages.text: Two knives:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Copper Knife$(): 171 durability, 1.5 damage$(li)$(thing)Amethyst Knife$(): 720 durability, 2.0 + 0.5 damage, mining level 3, enchantability 10$(br2)Both are in the $(thing)c:tools/knives$() tag and are interchangeable at the $(l:moderndelight:kitchenwares/cuisine_table)Cuisine Table$() — the recipes do not care which you use. The amethyst knife does have a special drop when it kills a squid.

pages.title: Crowbar
pages.text: A wrench in all but name: right-click to $(thing)rotate$() this mod's machines and blocks (freezer door, deep fryer, furnaces and so on).$(br2)$(thing)Sneak and right-click$() breaks blocks quickly instead.$(br2)Right-click an $(thing)Oven$() with a crowbar to turn it back into an Advanced Furnace, dropping one baking tray.

pages.title: Kitchen Utensil Holder
pages.text: Holds $(thing)four$() items.$(br2)Right-click with an item to put one in; right-click empty-handed to take the topmost one out.$(br2)It is not picky — spatulas, knives and spoons all look fine in it.
